__README: Committed config for monday-sync.js. NOT secret - only MONDAY_TOKEN is a secret. Board 'Dorotape Dev' was created via the API with these exact ids. After ANY change to the board, run: node .github/scripts/monday-sync.js check
__columnTypes: Each column must be the TYPE listed here, not merely exist - check verifies this and refuses mismatches. ref=Text, status=Status, branch=Text, pr=Link, commit=Text, deployedAt=Date, deployResult=Status, checksResult=Status, lastRun=Link. Do not point two entries at one column id; check rejects that too, because those writes would overwrite each other.
__boardSetup: Status labels must match 'labels' below exactly - 'In progress' is lowercase p, and a mismatch fails loudly rather than inventing a label. The token's user needs a MEMBER seat; a viewer seat reads fine and fails every write. To rediscover ids: node .github/scripts/monday-sync.js discover --board 18424565446
__statusIndex5: If you ever rebuild a Status column, leave label index 5 EMPTY. monday treats index 5 as the column's blank slot, so any label sitting there is what every unset item reports - the first build of this board put 'QA' at index 5 and every new ticket read as already in QA while its stored value was still null. check refuses to pass if index 5 is occupied. The index is not visible in the UI; only the API shows it.
__timezone: Only affects the human-readable stamp in comments. The 'Deployed at' COLUMN is always stored in UTC and monday renders it in each viewer's own profile timezone, so set this to match yours (monday profile: Africa/Johannesburg) or the comment and the column will disagree by an hour. Comments always name the zone, so a teammate in another zone can still read them.
__devUrl: The dev site URL is NOT here. It is the DEV_SITE_URL repo variable (or a gitignored .env locally), because it points at an environment - a copy of this repo for another project must not inherit the old URL. This file describes the board only.
